help: usage: fleet-switchboard disk [-h] [--docker DOCKER] {report,prune,reap-docker,janitor,janitor-ack,reap-orphans,reclaim-worktrees,register-worktree} ... positional arguments: {report,prune,reap-docker,janitor,janitor-ack,reap-orphans,reclaim-worktrees,register-worktree} report what holds the disk: free space, docker usage, worktrees per agent, cache sizes, orphan candidates (read only; also a bare `disk`) prune docker builder prune, docker image prune -a (older than a week) and, on docker 23.0 or newer, docker volume prune -f (anonymous volumes only), and nothing else reap-docker remove EXPIRED docker containers, networks and volumes that carry fleet.owner and fleet.expires labels janitor remove old, unnamed entries of the opencode temp directory (a dry run unless --apply) janitor-ack record the yes to the temp janitor's would-remove preview (the Chief of Staff's or the operator's) reap-orphans Signal (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL) orphaned test helpers past the grace: parent launchd, an exact allow-list; a dry run unless --apply reclaim-worktrees Remove the registered worktrees of retired agents when clean and pushed; else keep and say why (a dry run unless --apply) register-worktree Record a linked worktree for an agent (launch records its own) options: -h, --help show this help message and exit --docker DOCKER The docker executable the bare `disk` report asks (default: docker on PATH)
